name: IEEE 4-node test feeder, grounded-wye / grounded-wye step-down, balanced load
description: IEEE PES Distribution System Analysis Subcommittee, IEEE 4 Node Test Feeder (W. H. Kersting), published case Y-Y (grounded wye - grounded wye) step-down, balanced load. Infinite 12.47 kV source at node 1; 2000 ft overhead line 1-2; 6000 kVA 12.47/4.16 kV transformer 2-3 with Z = 1.0 + j6.0 %; 2500 ft overhead line 3-4; wye constant-power load at node 4 of 1800 kW per phase at 0.9 pf lagging. The line code is the published line geometry (phase conductors 336,400 26/7 ACSR at x = -4, -1.5, 3 ft and h = 28 ft; neutral 4/0 6/1 ACSR at x = 0, h = 24 ft) reduced to a 3x3 phase impedance by Kersting's modified Carson equations (60 Hz, 100 ohm-m earth) and Kron reduction of the neutral (computed by GridSim from the published geometry; the phase-a self impedance is 0.4576 + j1.0780 ohm/mile). Line shunt capacitance is neglected (the published geometry gives none in this file's line code, and its effect here is below 0.01 %). Published node voltages: see GridSim technical ch. 18 (worked example, the IEEE 4-node feeder) and tests/GridSim.Tests/MultiPhaseJsonLoaderTests.cs.
